name: Monk of the Lotus
summary: A peaceful master who replaces lethal vibrations and supernatural travel with serenity, surrender, lasting peace, and learned wisdom.

features.name: Touch of Serenity
features.summary: Gain Touch of Serenity without meeting its prerequisites; its duration increases at 6th, 12th, and 18th level.

features.name: Touch of Surrender
features.summary: When a melee attack would reduce a creature to 0 hit points, spend 6 ki to leave it disabled and charmed without a save.

features.name: Touch of Peace
features.summary: Once per day, make a harmless melee touch that charms the target for 1 day per Monk level without a save.

features.name: Learned Master
features.summary: All Knowledge skills and Linguistics become class skills and use Wisdom instead of Intelligence.
